name: blueprint
description: Where vibe coding starts: turn an idea, or a project you already have, into PRD, SPEC and TASKS docs a coding agent builds from without guessing.

interface.shortDescription: Where vibe coding starts: PRD, SPEC and TASKS before the code
interface.longDescription: Blueprint is where vibe coding starts. Give it an idea, or point it at a project you already have, and it writes the plan a coding agent builds from without guessing: a PRD (why and what), a SPEC (how) and TASKS (ordered, checkable steps). It makes the planning decisions itself, asks at most once for what no file can tell it, reviews its own documents, and ends with the one step that starts the build. It can also document an existing project, with pointers into the code and tasks for what to fix, or plan a rebuild from zero on the core idea, with a transition for every contract it changes.
defaultPrompt: Use Blueprint to turn my app idea into PRD, SPEC, and TASKS docs.
Use Blueprint to plan this model before we write any code.
Use Blueprint to document this existing project so I can understand and improve it.
Use Blueprint to plan a rebuild of this project from scratch.
